name: @yousen/dsh-novel-mode
description: Adds a 小说模式 (Novel Mode) entry to the DeepSeek Harness session mode dropdown: a selectable agent preset carrying the complete long-form novel writing workflow (constitution, outline, design, writing, batch, validation) with bundled skills, subagent roles, templates and validation scripts.
descriptionZh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的会话模式下拉框新增可选「小说模式」：内置长篇小说写作工作流（宪法、大纲、设计、写作、批量、校验）所需的技能、子代理角色、模板与校验脚本。
